name: Blue Flow Fandisc
original_name: ブルーフロウ ファンディスク
source: It contains 3 standalone missions that can be played without the original game. In addition, it includes artwork collection, walkthrough for Blue Flow, desktop accessories, RASETSU, RASETSU 2, Blue Flow game demos, 3-episode audio drama CD.
translation: 收录3个无需原作即可游玩的独立任务。此外还包含美术设定集、《Blue Flow》攻略、桌面小工具、《RASETSU》《RASETSU 2》《Blue Flow》试玩版，以及收录3集广播剧的CD。
